name: cosmoduck-widgets
description: Blue frosted-glass widget set: two-layer clock, calendar, ring gauges, weather, network, processes, real Apple-Silicon sensors (macmon) and Claude Code token usage, with an accent palette derived from the wallpaper in use, or chosen on the back of each widget. Draggable & lockable. A port of the Regulus/Cosmoduck Conky theme.
author: msavox
